dstack._note: Intel TDX boxes on dstack. osImages = approved dstack OS releases (mrTd + rtmr0..2, from a reproducible build); composeHashes = approved app-compose hashes (they pin the AGT box image digest). Empty = nothing approved yet.

azureAci._note: Azure Confidential Containers (AMD SEV-SNP), verified against AMD's root key. hostData = sha256 of the approved container security policy (pins the box image, no exec); measurements = approved utility-VM launch measurements. Empty = nothing approved yet.

tcb._note: Patch level. intelAccept = Intel TCB statuses accepted (from Intel's signed TCB info). amdMin = minimum SPLs per AMD product from AMD security bulletins (empty = VCEK/TCB binding and CRL only). Raise as bulletins come out.
